title: Scan.toml [rule] filters (include-and-exclude) with custom analyzers
description: Upstream fixture: Scan.toml declares exampleOrg/ballerina/ballerinax analyzers plus a [rule] table that sets both include and exclude. From 0.13.0 that is a Scan.toml error at the location of the table (Scan.toml has 1 error / Scan.toml:17:1: error: cannot include and exclude rules at the same time), found while the file is read, so every step fails the same way, --list-rules and the CLI rule options included. Earlier versions fail only once the rules are resolved, and --list-rules still lists the rules.

steps.name: --list-rules
steps.note: From 0.13.0 the invalid Scan.toml stops --list-rules too.

steps.name: Scan.toml + CLI include
steps.note: The CLI option would replace [rule], but the file is checked first, so this is still the Scan.toml error.
